title: White Rice with Cheese and/or Cream Based Sauce, No Added Fat

content.title: About
content.content: This is boiled white rice served with a sauce made from cheese and/or cream that is prepared without added fat. The rice provides a light, neutral base, while the sauce adds a gentle creamy flavor without extra calories from fat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: White rice is one of the most widely consumed grains worldwide.
A fat‑free creamy sauce is made from low‑fat cottage cheese, skim milk, or plant‑based alternatives.
Such dishes are common in dietetic menus and for people monitoring their fat intake.
Rice is easily digestible and often used in therapeutic diets for gastrointestinal issues.
Combining rice with cheese improves calcium bioavailability.

items.title: Source of carbohydrates
items.content: Rice provides a quick source of energy through complex carbohydrates, useful for post‑exercise recovery.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: It contains thiamine, niacin, and vitamin B6, which support metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Calcium from cheese
items.content: The cheese sauce adds calcium, essential for bone and tooth health.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Absence of added fat makes the dish suitable for low‑fat dietary plans.

items.title: Protein
items.content: The cheese sauce supplies a modest amount of complete protein, aiding tissue repair.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: The cheese sauce may contain lactose, which can cause discomfort for lactose‑intolerant individuals.

items.title: Milk allergy
items.content: People allergic to dairy proteins should avoid this sauce.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: White rice has a high glycemic index, so portion control is important for people with diabetes.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: If the sauce is seasoned with salt, total sodium intake should be monitored.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the rice hot, drizzled with the cheese or cream sauce. Garnish with fresh herbs, green onions, or spices to taste. The dish works as a main course or as a side to lean meat or fish.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep cooked rice in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Store the sauce separately in a sealed container, also for up to 3 days. Reheat to at least 75 °C before serving.
